A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the elicitation strategy is a promising approach for the production of secondary metabolites by hairy root cultures.

vanadyl sulfate is a better abiotic elicitor than the autoclaved cell filtrates of B.cinereae, whereas P. gravidus filtrate is a better biotic elicitor than B.cinerea filtrate for the production of thiarubrines in the hairy root cultures of A. artemsisiifolia.
the use of statistical methods is a very effective way to optimize the elicitation conditions for the enhancement of secondary metabolite production.

elicitation can be used as a tool for yield enhancement of the secondary metabolites in plant cell culture.
